line.title: channel top hidden behind the neck plates — welded to BOTH plates along this lap (ER-005)
shoulder rebate — 8 mm into each side wall along the channel top; plates lap here, web stands proud between them (ER-005)
shoulder weld — horizontal fillet, plate bottom edge to midrib side wall, both plates (ER-005); position mirrors id=shoulder-weld in Erand49.svg
horizontal end cut — the midrib stands on the floor as the rear foot
midrib tube centerline (top face carries the string anchors)
pillar — Ø2" × 3/16" round tube, crown to floor, through the midrib (ER-004)

svg.text: pillar into midrib + floor foot: ER-004
